obligations.summary: The public straight-RGBA16LE value is externally constructible, exact, tightly packed, and rejects an invalid byte count.
The fixed explicit-sRGB 16-bit PNG probes deterministically to the exact 2x1 single-frame facts and reports 16 source bits per component.
Preflight resource authority is deterministic, fully bounded for the profile, caller-source composable, and publishes straight-RGBA16LE layout authority.
The fixed PNG decodes deterministically to exact tight straight little-endian RGBA16 bytes and the transfer ledger equals the returned value charge.
Encoded-byte, format, dimension and pixel hard limits fail closed against the fixed PNG before any successful packed output is published.
Color conversion, high-dynamic-range requests, and target mismatch are outside the v1 public profile and fail closed at both ledger and decode boundaries.
Untagged and sBIT-bearing 16-bit PNG fixtures are outside the explicit-sRGB no-extra-metadata profile and fail closed before packed publication.
A factory configured with an operation budget below the minimum possible output cannot successfully admit the reference 16-bit PNG.
